result.intro: cole and harper basically gave you dallas on foot — quiet art corners and cheap transit moves. sticking to free / super cheap since you're holding that $300 line.

items.title: painted pillars in deep ellum
items.what: overpass pillars painted like trees under the highway in deep ellum. cole caught it on a quiet sunday afternoon with nobody out yet. just walk it and look up.
items.whyYou: you're into art people — this is that dallas joke maya called out, painted trees next to real ones.

evidence.caption: deep ellum on a sunday afternoon when it's quiet. the overpass pillars painted like trees, then actual trees and grass in the little park past them, brick buildings behind. nobody's out yet. truck's in the lot, spare bedroom in lower greenville's empty, come up
evidence.sawLive: super quiet and chill, painted tree pillars under the overpass opening up to a grassy park with real trees. easy walk on the sidewalks at the street corner, brick buildings behind the park.

items.title: little park past the pillars
items.what: grassy patch with real trees right past the painted pillars, brick buildings behind. chill loop, sidewalks are easy, good for a stretch-your-legs walk from cole's.
items.whyYou: you're into hikers — not a real trail but a good daytime wander while you're staying with cole.

evidence.sawLive: super quiet and chill, painted tree pillars under the overpass opening up to a grassy park with real trees. easy walk on the sidewalks at the street corner, brick buildings behind the park.

items.title: dart day pass move
items.what: harper's tip from the fair run: skip the $25 weekend parking, ride the dart instead. $6 all day, she did it from oak cliff and owen says it was easy.
items.whyYou: you've got a car but this keeps it cheap — pocket the parking money for food.

evidence.caption: big tex standing over the cacti with his arms out like he's about to hug 100k people. cotton bowl behind him, texas flag, the whole fair. fletcher's corny dog is $10 now which is a crime but I paid it. go on a weekday, parking's $25 on weekends, ride the dart instead, $6 all day
